remarks:
Excellent investment opportunity at 1930 Welch Ave in Niagara Falls! This fully renovated 2-unit property features separate upper and lower apartments, with each unit offering 2 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom.

Both apartments have been updated with new flooring, new windows, modern appliances, and a new HVAC system, making this a strong turn-key property for an investor. Both units are currently tenanted and generating good rental income, providing immediate cash flow from day one.

The property is also located within an Airbnb-permitted zone, adding extra future flexibility for an investor who may want to explore short-term rental potential, subject to all applicable City requirements and licensing.

With two updated units, solid existing income, and a desirable Niagara Falls location, this property offers a great combination of current rental performance and long-term upside.

Please note that both units are occupied, so all showings require a minimum of 48 hours’ notice.
